seo.titulo: Clipfine app for iPhone and Android: your clients' clips | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Edit, schedule and approve your clients' clips from your phone, with the same account as the web. An iPhone and Android app built for agencies.

bajada: The app is part of Clipfine, on iPhone and Android: same account, same clients, everything in sync with the web. Approve, edit or schedule from wherever you are.

d2.que: the same as on the web, with all your clients

agencia.app: Nobody has to set anything up again to work from their phone.
agencia.sincronizado: What an editor leaves on the web, you pick up on your phone, no files passed around.
agencia.editarCelular: A last-minute fix doesn't wait for someone to get back to the office.
agencia.aprobarCelular: The client approves from their phone and the clip goes out on time.
agencia.push: You hear about what needs your attention without keeping Clipfine open.
agencia.fotos: The finished clip is on the phone, ready to send or post wherever it's needed.

sincronizado.pie: The same on the web and on the phone

push.aviso: Leo scheduled a clip for Thursday
push.pie: You choose which alerts you get

p1.p: Do I need another account for the app?
p1.r: No. Sign in with the same account as the web and your clients, episodes and clips are already there.

p2.p: Can I edit a full clip from my phone?
p2.r: Yes. Trim, remove what's extra, change captions and text, add music and sound effects, adjust the speed and schedule on all four networks.

p3.p: Can my client approve from their phone?
p3.r: Yes. With the Reviewer role, they see the clip in the app and approve it or request changes, in writing or with a voice note.
